title: Affine chart and slice scalar transport
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], U an affine open, A=Gamma(X,U), and M any sheaf of modules on Spec A. Let f be an endomorphism of M acting as multiplication by a in A on sections of every open. After restriction along hU.isoSpec.hom, inverse slice equivalence, and ordinary direct image [def-sc-affine-free-basis-germs], f acts as multiplication by a on sections over U.

proof.text: Unfold the transported morphism on sections and apply its sectionwise scalar hypothesis. Use Scheme.Modules.smul_Spec_def and ModuleCat.restrictScalars.smul_def to expose the two ring scalars. Apply injectivity of the chart appIso.hom to compare them. Rewrite appIso.hom as appLE and use naturality, followed by IsAffineOpen.isoSpec_hom_appTop. The GammaSpecIso inverse identity leaves the chart restriction. Unfold the slice ring comparison and U.topIso; both sides are composites of the same restriction maps between opens, whose arrows are equal because the opens category is thin. This argument constructs no basis or germs, and includes the empty open.

lean.statement:
theorem affine_chart_scalar_transport (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.Opens)
    (hU : IsAffineOpen U) (a : Γ(X, U))
    (M : (Spec Γ(X, U)).Modules) (f : M ⟶ M)
    (hf : ∀ (V : (Spec Γ(X, U)).Opens) (s : Γ(M, V)),
      (f.val.app (.op V)) s = a • s) :
    let T := Modules.restrictFunctor hU.isoSpec.hom ⋙ (Modules.overEquiv U).inverse
    let P := SheafOfModules.pushforward.{u}
      (SheafOfModules.pushforwardOver (R := moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U)
    ∀ m : (P.obj (T.obj M)).val.obj (.op U),
      (P.map (T.map f)).val.app (.op U) m = a • m
